C1.reason: The results are existence guarantees for fairness criteria (AX) and complexity results (AL); no result measures rule performance against a welfare optimum or distortion, so WD does not apply.

C2.4.reason: The input is called approval ballots rather than preferences, so IDU does not fit, and the text separates the private utility functions from what is observed.

C4.1.reason: The paper formally defines voter satisfaction as a function of the approval input, which matches the SPEC examples.

C5.2.reason: The paper does relate the ballot-based welfare to held attitudes, saying it approximates private utility using the available information, so INPUT-UNSTATED does not fit.

C6.VOT.reason: Voters submit approval ballots, which counts as an action even when fixed, so voters are present and non-strategic by implication from the formal model.
